design_configuration.nominal_note: Approximate artistic design envelope, not measured fossil size; measured source and GLB XYZ bounds recorded separately after build.
design_configuration.interpretation: One elongated capsule with curved basal stalk, actual thick longitudinal ribbed wall and upper split exposing three embedded spirally grooved ellipsoid seeds. Horizontal Y axis, opening +Z. Capsule posterior and underside are solid closed wall. Few visible seeds simplify many in-situ seeds; not complete anatomical locule reconstruction. Family affinity remains debated; no parent plant or isolated seed asset.
design_configuration.revision_reason: Make spiral seed grooves visibly readable in clay: broaden and deepen geometric grooves and increase circumferential sampling; retain capsule and three embedded seeds.
